title: GSAP ScrollTrigger Storytelling
concept: Lowlathe Pressworks, a fictional Ghent vinyl plant: one pinned, scrubbed story follows order A-2219 from lacquer cut through nickel stamper, PVC biscuit, 150-tonne press, flash trim and test listen, with a live Pressline panel counting each state, then hands off to formats, plant stats and a clip-path booking reveal.
notes: GSAP + ScrollTrigger (installed), no Lenis. One timeline with a label per step, scrub 0.8, gsap.matchMedia for desktop/mobile/reduced-motion; under reduced motion nothing pins and the story renders as a static list. The record and all product states are inline SVG/CSS, no images.
